suites.title: Build
suites.describe: build() makes a Deva that reaches ready.

suites.title: Init
suites.describe: init() resolves with the ready data, waits for onReady, and a failing step or onError reject stops the chain.

suites.title: Feature Getters
suites.describe: Each feature getter returns exactly its own _key data as a copy, carries the client and its concerns, and answers offline after stop().

suites.title: Hash
suites.describe: The md5, sha256 and sha512 tiers match node:crypto, every hashing site carries all three, the uid fingerprint holds, and one changed field breaks every tier.

suites.title: License
suites.describe: A matching VLA activates the Deva with stamped hashes; a changed, missing or absent VLA answers its message and stays inactive.

suites.title: Messaging
suites.describe: question() runs local /commands and #ask calls to child Devas, child errors reach the asker right away, and missing or silent targets answer not found or timeout.

suites.title: Shutdown
suites.describe: stop() stops child Devas first, runs the full chain in order to onShutdown, clears features, answers pending asks offline and leaves nothing on the event bus.

suites.title: Help
suites.describe: help() returns the right feecting section by file and part, answers help not found for a missing file or section as invalid and bad without an error or a good intent, and answers offline before init and after stop.

suites.title: Error
suites.describe: err() rejects or hands off to onError without calling context(), talks one stamped error packet, and context() and contexts() read each Deva's own vars.context, falling back safely when it is missing.

edgecases.title: Child errors reach the asker
edgecases.describe: A failing or throwing child Deva method now rejects the asker right away instead of waiting for the ask timeout.

edgecases.title: Pending asks at shutdown
edgecases.describe: A question still waiting on an answer when the Deva stops now resolves offline instead of hanging.

edgecases.title: Parent stop reaches its children
edgecases.describe: A parent's stop() now stops each child Deva through its full chain before the parent closes.

edgecases.title: Missing help section
edgecases.describe: A missing section resolved help not found but kept going, threw, logged an error, and the finally block logged valid and good on both not-found paths.
